## Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of the problem you're trying to solve or the limitation you want to address.

## Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like to see implemented.

## Alternative Solutions
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or examples that might help illustrate the feature request.

## Implementation Notes
If you have thoughts on how this should be implemented, include them here.
